ha.onboarding.brandDuaTranslation: Ya Allah, babu sauƙi face abin da Ka sa sauƙi, Ka kuma sa abin da yayi wahala sauƙi idan Ka so.
ha.onboarding.slide1Body: Alama kowace salah a tafiyarku ta komawa zuwa Allah — an gama, an ɓace, an jinkirta, ko qaza.
ha.onboarding.slide1Highlight1: Addu'o'in farilla biyar tare da Witr (sunnah mu'akkadah) da sunnah
ha.onboarding.slide1Highlight2: Jerin kwanaki, zoben ci gaba, da kalanda
ha.onboarding.slide1Highlight3: Lokutan salah tare da kwanan wata Hijri da ƙidaya zuwa ga lokaci
ha.onboarding.slide2Body: Canza qaza daga mai wahala zuwa abin da za a iya — ƙididdige, tsara gudu, kuma bi diddigin azumi.
ha.onboarding.slide2Highlight1: Ƙididdigar salah da aka daidaita daga tracker dinku
ha.onboarding.slide2Highlight2: Kalkuleta ta rayuwa tare da jagorar masana
ha.onboarding.slide2Highlight3: Mai tsara gudu na yau da yau tare da ETA don share sauran aiki
ha.onboarding.slide3Body: Safe, yamma, da adhkar na yanayi tare da ƙididdigar tasbeeh mai taɓawa.
ha.onboarding.slide3Highlight2: Tasbeeh kyauta tare da saiti da manufofi na al'ada
ha.onboarding.slide3Highlight3: Tunatarwa kafin barci da ta san lokacin barci
ha.onboarding.slide4Title: Alkur'ani, hadisi & dua ba tare da layi ba
ha.onboarding.slide4Body: Karanta, nema, da sauraro — an haɗa don tafiya tare da zaɓin tunatarwa mai laushi.
ha.onboarding.slide4Highlight1: Cikakken Alkur'ani tare da karatu da neman ayah
ha.onboarding.slide4Highlight3: Lokutan salah, kamfas na qibla, da zaɓin tunatarwa
ha.onboarding.ctaBody: Komai yana aiki ba tare da layi ba a na'urarku. Shiga a kowane lokaci don daidaita a kan wayoyi da kwamfutoci.
ha.onboarding.ctaPrivacyBody: Ba a buƙatar asusu. Bayananku na ibada suna kan na'urarku har sai kun zaɓi ajiyewa da daidaitawa.
ha.language.translationHint: Ana amfani da shi don ma'anar rubutun addini na Larabci.
ha.language.footer: Ƙarin ɓangaren app yana fassarwa a hankali. Larabci da Urdu suna canza app zuwa tsarin daga dama zuwa hagu.
ha.language.subtitle: Yaren app da fassara

sw.onboarding.brandDuaTranslation: Ee Mwenyezi Mungu, hakuna urahisi isipokuwa katika ulichofanya kuwa rahisi, na Wewe hufanya ugumu kuwa rahisi ukipenda.
sw.onboarding.slide1Body: Weka alama kila swala katika safari yako ya kurudi kwa Allah — iliyokamilika, iliyokosa, iliyochelewa, au qaza.
sw.onboarding.slide1Highlight1: Swala tano za farz pamoja na Witr (sunnah mu'akkadah) na sunnah
sw.onboarding.slide1Highlight2: Mfululizo, pete ya maendeleo, na kalenda
sw.onboarding.slide1Highlight3: Nyakati za swala na tarehe ya Hijri na kuhesabu muda
sw.onboarding.slide2Body: Geuza qaza kutoka kuwa mzito kuwa inayoweza kufanyika — kadiria, panga mwendo, na fuatilia kufunga.
sw.onboarding.slide2Highlight1: Vihesabio vya swala vilivyosawazishwa kutoka kifuatiliaji chako
sw.onboarding.slide2Highlight2: Kikokotoo cha maisha chenye mwongozo wa wasomi
sw.onboarding.slide2Highlight3: Mpango wa mwendo wa kila siku na makadirio ya kumaliza deni
sw.onboarding.slide3Body: Asubuhi, jioni, na adhkar za hali pamoja na kihesabu cha tasbeeh cha mguso.
sw.onboarding.slide3Highlight2: Tasbeeh ya bure yenye mipangilio na malengo maalum
sw.onboarding.slide3Highlight3: Vikumbusho kabla ya kulala vinavyojua wakati wa kulala
sw.onboarding.slide4Body: Soma, tafuta, na sikiliza — imejumuishwa kwa safari na vikumbusho vya upole.
sw.onboarding.slide4Highlight1: Qur'an kamili na usomaji na utafutaji wa aya
sw.onboarding.slide4Highlight3: Nyakati za swala, dira ya qibla, na vikumbusho vya hiari
sw.onboarding.ctaBody: Kila kitu kinafanya kazi nje ya mtandao kwenye kifaa chako. Ingia wakati wowote ili kusawazisha kwenye simu na kompyuta kibao.
sw.onboarding.ctaPrivacyBody: Hakuna akaunti inayohitajika. Data yako ya ibada inabaki kwenye kifaa hadi uchague chelezo na usawazishaji.
sw.language.translationHint: Inatumika kwa maana ya maandishi ya kidini ya Kiarabu.
sw.language.footer: Sehemu zaidi za kiolesura zinatafsiriwa kadri muda unavyopita. Kiarabu na Kiurdu hubadilisha mpangilio wa kulia-kushoto.
sw.language.scriptureUnavailable: Kiolesura tu — maandishi ya kidini hubaki kwa Kiingereza
